Epic: bd-01M1Z987V50254M59P9MNGP9FH
Delivery phase: 1 of 6; child 2 of 12.
Design: docs/design/interaction.md; full snapshot retained in the epic note.
Status: planned work; no implementation or passing evidence is asserted.

Scope
Implement pure transitions for hover, focus, selection, gesture mode, and viewport state. Normalize input records and support disabled/single/multiple selection with replace, add, subtract, toggle, clear, initial state, and programmatic updates. Attach origin and plan revision to events.

Acceptance criteria
1. Identical initial state and normalized traces produce identical results on JVM and Scala.js.
2. Pointer, keyboard, and programmatic activation carry the same typed target identity and payload.
3. Stale events are rejected; replacing data reconciles entity keys and reports removed/unresolved keys under an explicit persistence policy.
4. Projected state is not re-emitted as a fresh user action. Selection survives viewport changes and hidden marks.
5. Document and test hover/focus/selection/external-style precedence; focus remains visible.

Exclusions
Browser effects, full history persistence, and source-member resolution belong to later tasks.

Required evidence
State laws and trace fixtures that independently state expected events and selected keys, including cancellation, stale revisions, and duplicate deliveries.
Retain tested source SHA, fixture inputs, expected outputs, and actual gate results. Pending or unavailable checks remain explicitly pending.

Prerequisites
bd-01M1Z9B131PK2DW4D6004XQ5Q4

Coordination
Reserve only actual files when implementation starts. Parent containment is not a prerequisite on the epic; do not create a child-to-epic dependency cycle.
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction 02] Implement deterministic interaction state and typed application events
